# UnNecessaryDoubleQuotes

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UnNecessaryDoubleQuotesInspection`

A double-quoted string that contains no interpolation and no escape sequence
behaves exactly like a single-quoted one. Single quotes make it obvious that
nothing is evaluated inside.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5} [Before]
<?php
$label  = "ready";
$price  = "\$9 \"net\"";
$none   = "";
$dollar = "cost: $";

$kept1 = 'already single';
$kept2 = "hello {$name}";
$kept3 = "it's";
$kept4 = "line\n";
$kept5 = "C:\\temp";
$kept6 = <<<TXT
body
TXT;
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
$label  = 'ready';
$price  = '$9 "net"';
$none   = '';
$dollar = 'cost: $';
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: No interpolation or escapes here; use single quotes.</li>
<li>line 3: No interpolation or escapes here; use single quotes.</li>
<li>line 4: No interpolation or escapes here; use single quotes.</li>
<li>line 5: No interpolation or escapes here; use single quotes.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnNecessaryDoubleQuotes": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnNecessaryDoubleQuotes

/**
 * @noinspection UnNecessaryDoubleQuotesInspection
 */
```
